fit.reason: the record holds 4 frames and fewer than two lags fall between 1000.0 s and 3000.0 s; the run stopped before the fit range was filled

uncertainty.reason: fewer than two blocks produced a fit

window_sensitivity.reason: one half of the fit range has fewer than two lags or a non-positive slope

persistence_time.estimator: contracts/observables.json: persistence_time -- exponential fit to the orientational autocorrelation over the declared lag window
